review_scope: English qualitative manuscript excerpt; supplied draft only; no external research or additional research materials used.
substantive_findings: C1: blue, major; recruitment and entry into teams need reporting verification; absence in excerpt is not treated as evidence of misconduct or invalid methods.
C2: blue, major; analytic comparison, case selection and source attribution need reporting verification; no imposed quantitative criteria.

C3: red, major; paragraph universalizing silence as deliberate resistance/intent conflicts with the provided contrast and heterogeneous interpretation, and equal influence is not established by the excerpt.
preserved_reasoning: The heterogeneous interpretation of silence and subsequent leadership recommendation are retained; no blanket weakening of qualitative claims.

visual_checks.method: Rendered PNGs opened using view_image and visually inspected.
visual_checks.findings: Text is readable and page geometry unchanged. Blue highlights anchor only the two methods passages; red highlight covers the overclaim paragraph. Original yellow note remains. No tables or figures are present. Adjacent blue ranges meet at the sentence boundary but do not overlap.
visual_checks.native_comment_contents: Read back from annotated PDF and inspected in full.
